data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is delighted to present this extraordinary 5 bedroom villa in the highly sought after Address Hillcrest in Dubai Hills Estate by Emaar. This villa offer a premium lifestyle surrounded by lush greenery, tranquil lagoon feature, and world class amenities.

Property Features

Fully Furnished & Upgraded
Cinema | Bar | Gaming Area
Brand New, never lived in
Vacant & ready to move in
On Main Lagoon
Best Location in the cluster
One of a kind within the community
5 modern bedrooms with 7 bathrooms
Stunning lake and landscaped community views
Built in wardrobes and spacious walk in closets
Open plan kitchen and back-kitchen space
Large garden and spacious balconies
Separate maid's room and driver's room
Huge Basement floor
Dedicated study and laundry areas
Smart home technology integration
Covered parking and private garage

Perfect for families and investors alike, this villa provides exceptional privacy, comfort, and exclusivity in one of Dubai s most prestigious master communities.
